        boolean neg = false;
        try {
            BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
            int c;
            boolean start = false;
            while ((c = br.read()) != -1) {
                if (c == '-') {
                    start = true;
                    neg = true;
                    continue;
                } else if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
                    start = true;
                    ans = ans * 10 + c - '0';
                } else if (start) break;
            }
        } catch (IOException e) {
        }
        return neg ? -ans : ans;
    }

    int r, c;
    Scanner sca = new Scanner(System.in);
    long[][] C = new long[64][64];
    long best = Long.MAX_VALUE;

    void dfs(long x, long y, int v1, int v2) {
        long d = Math.abs(x - y);
        if (best <= 1 || d - C[v1][r]*C[v2][r] >= best) return;
        if (v1 == 0 && v2 == 0) {
            if (d < best) best = d;
            return;
        }
        if (v1 > 0) {
            long c1 = C[v1][r] - C[v1-1][r], s2 = C[v2][r];
            dfs(x, y + c1*s2, v1 - 1, v2);
        }
        if (v2 > 0) {
            long s1 = C[v1][r], c2 = C[v2][r] - C[v2-1][r];
            dfs(x + s1*c2, y, v1, v2 - 1);
        }
    }

    int[] cntA = new int[64], cntB = new int[64];
    Map<Long, Long> cache = new TreeMap<>();
    char[] cs;

    long solve(long x, long y, int v1, int v2) {
        long k = x*10000 + v1*100  + v2;
        Long v = cache.get(k);
        if (v != null) return v;
        v = 0l;
        long d = Math.abs(x - y);
        if (d - C[v1][r]*C[v2][r] > best) {
            cache.put(k, v);
            return v;
        }
        if (v1 == 0 && v2 == 0) return 1;
        char c = cs[v1 + v2 - 1];
        if (v1 > 0 && c != 'B') {
            long c1 = C[v1][r] - C[v1 - 1][r], s2 = C[v2][r];
            v += solve(x, y + c1*s2, v1 - 1, v2);
        }
        if (v2 > 0 && c != 'A') {
            long s1 = C[v1][r], c2 = C[v2][r] - C[v2-1][r];
            v += solve( x + s1*c2, y, v1, v2 - 1);
        }
        cache.put(k, v);
        return v;
    }

    void start() {
        r = sca.nextInt(); c = sca.nextInt(); sca.nextLine();
        cs = sca.nextLine().toCharArray();
        for (int i = 0; i <= 2*(r + c); i++)
            for (int j = 0; j <= 2*(r + c); j++) {
                if (j == 0) C[i][j] = 1;
                else if (i == 0) C[i][j] = 0;
                else C[i][j] = C[i-1][j - 1] + C[i - 1][j];
            }
        int v1 = r + c, v2 = r + c;
        long x = 0, y = 0;
        while (v1 >= r && v2 >= r) {
            if (x > y) {
                long c1 = C[v1][r] - C[v1 - 1][r], s2 = C[v2][r];
                y += c1*s2;
                v1--;
            } else {
                long s1 = C[v1][r], c2 = C[v2][r] - C[v2-1][r];
                x += s1*c2;
                v2--;
            }
        }
        best = Math.abs(x - y);
        dfs(0, 0, r + c, r + c);
        for (int i = 0; i < 2*(r+c); i++) {
            cntA[i + 1] = cntA[i] + (cs[i] == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
            cntB[i + 1] = cntB[i] + (cs[i] == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
